flow: Prospect, Audit, Diagnosis, Brand identity, Content strategy, Carousel, Review, Export.

audit.title: Audit
audit.text: Analyze a prospect's website, social profiles and competitors, and deliver the report as a PDF.

templates.title: Templates
templates.text: Import and publish the agency's templates: reports and carousels use only published ones.

brand.title: Brand Identity
brand.text: The client's strategy, voice and visual identity, approved by a person.

products.title: Products
products.text: The client's catalog: only approved products make it into content.

content.title: Content
content.text: Strategy, plan, carousels, review and export to PNG, PDF and ZIP.
